described.name: Authorization
described.description: Rewst API token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <REWST_API_TOKEN>`

described.name: approveUserInvite
described.description: Approve a pending user invite. Only org admins or staff can approve requests. This will send the invite email to the user.

described.name: authorizedPermissions
described.description: FORM_GRANTS ids (e.g. `form_viewer`, `form_editor`) granted by this role. System roles return defaults from POLICY.md; custom roles return their authorizedPermissions array (filtered to valid form grant ids).

described.name: bulkFormPermissionsAudit
described.description: Org-wide audit projection used by the permissions report CSV builder. Returns one row per form. Unlike `formPermissionState`, this does not enumerate users: only users with explicit ALLOW overrides are surfaced. Role grants are computed from system-role defaults overlaid with explicit role overrides. Issues one Postgres query per category (forms, overrides, triggers, org_roles, users-for-overrides) regardless of form count.

described.name: bulkOrganizationsAudit
described.description: Org-wide audit projection used by the permissions report CSV builder. Returns one entry per organization in the caller's subtree (orgId + descendants), each with its assigned roles and the form-grant IDs those roles carry (system role defaults or the custom role's authorized permissions). Single query — no per-role round trips.

described.name: bulkSetFormPermissions
described.description: Apply a single (permission, operation) to every subject matching the supplied scope in one transaction. The server expands the filter, so the client doesn't have to materialize an edit per user for column-header "Grant all" style actions.

described.name: crates
described.description: This public query returns all available crates within the Rewst platform.

described.name: customDomain
described.description: Custom Domain, if present

described.name: defaultManagingOrgId
described.description: The parent organization ID under which all imported orgs will be created. If a record specifies managingOrgId, it will be used instead (with authorization check).

described.name: descendantOrgCount
described.description: Number of descendant organizations beneath this org (excludes self), computed by descending the LTREE org hierarchy. LAZY BY CONVENTION: each resolution triggers a full LTREE descent. Frontend MUST only request this field from the Engine Next confirmation modal's dedicated query — do NOT include it in `getSelectedOrg` or any always-on query, or every selected-org refetch will pay the LTREE cost.

described.name: description
described.description: Description of the crate

described.name: description
described.description: Description of the integration

described.name: domain
described.description: Name of the Domain

described.name: externalId
described.description: External organization ID from an integration (e.g. PSA company ID). Used with psaPackConfigId to create org variable mappings.

described.name: faviconUrl
described.description: Favorite icon URL

described.name: formPermissionState
described.description: Users are server-paginated to bound per-request work (drawer bulk-checks every returned user × permission against peck-order). orgId is validated against the form's own org and its form_submission trigger authorized orgs; callers cannot enumerate users of arbitrary orgs through this query.

described.name: grantRoleToOrganizationMembers
described.description: Bulk-grant: every effective member of the org (and its descendants) inherits this role.

described.name: iconUrl
described.description: Icon url of the integration

described.name: importType
described.description: Import type identifier for tracking.

described.name: integrations
described.description: This public query returns all available integrations within the Rewst platform.

described.name: isFeatureFlagged
described.description: Indicates if the integration is feature-flagged

described.name: isPublic
described.description: Indicates if the integration should not be seen by the public

described.name: layout
described.description: Login page layout

described.name: loader
described.description: Login page loader enum

described.name: name
described.description: Name of the crate

described.name: name
described.description: Name of the integration

described.name: numInstalled
described.description: Number of integration installations made by organizations

described.name: organizationImport
described.description: Get a specific organization import by ID.

described.name: organizationImports
described.description: Get organization import history for a managing organization.

described.name: pageTitle
described.description: Page Title

described.name: parentName
described.description: Immediate parent org's name, when this org is a sub-org. Rendered as a secondary line under the org name so admins can tell siblings apart at a glance. Null for top-level orgs.

described.name: previewOrganizationImport
described.description: Preview the import without creating any organizations. Validates all records and returns categorization.

described.name: processOrganizationImport
described.description: Process the organization import, creating valid organizations. Returns the import record with all results.

described.name: psaFilterOptions
described.description: Fetch account type and status filter options from the specified PSA integration

described.name: psaOrganizations
described.description: Fetch organizations from the specified PSA integration, filtered by account types and statuses

described.name: psaPackConfigId
described.description: Pack config ID for the PSA integration. When provided, org variable mappings are created for each successfully imported organization using the record's externalId. The org variable name is derived from the pack's orgVariables schema.

described.name: recordPermissionsReportDownload
described.description: Record an audit-log entry for a permissions report download. Called by the Permissions Report modal after the CSV/ZIP successfully reaches the user's browser. The full role/user/permission matrix is a security-sensitive read; logging the download event (who, when, which report types) is required for SOC2-style audit trails.

described.name: records
described.description: Pre-parsed array of organization records to import.

described.name: resetFormPermissions
described.description: Delete every per-user and per-role override for a form in one transaction. The caller's own overrides are deleted like any other row — after reset, access falls back to role defaults + cascade.

described.name: resolvedTagIds
described.description: Resolved tag IDs from the provided tag names.

described.name: roleOrganizationMembershipCounts
described.description: Batched membership counts for the role list sidebar, scoped to the caller's managed subtree.

described.name: roleOrganizationMemberships
described.description: Orgs whose effective members inherit the role (bulk membership). When `includeSubOrgs` is true, descendants of each directly-granted org are included with `isDirectAssignment=false` (cascade preview). Direct rows always come back regardless of the flag. `limit` and `offset` are optional; omit both to return the full set.

described.name: setOrgTemporalEnabled
described.description: Toggle the org-level Engine Next (Temporal) setting for `orgId`. Cascade is opt-in: when `cascade` is true, enabling or disabling propagates the value to every descendant org via LTREE. Returns the upserted `organization_feature_preview_settings` rows so Apollo cache can update. Requires the caller to be an org admin who manages `orgId`. Staff-org callers must have support write access to the affected org(s). Gated by `ENABLE_WORKFLOW_TEMPORAL` for `orgId` or one of its managing orgs; calls return `TEMPORAL_DISABLED` when the flag is off for that org chain. Authz is enforced inside the resolver (isOrgAdminUser + verifyStaffOrgUserHasOrgWriteAccess + per-descendant verifyUserManagesOrg), NOT via a schema `@requires*` directive: org admins — not just staff/support — must be able to call this, which is finer-grained than the available directives express.

described.name: subjectSpicedbFlagEnabled
described.description: Whether the `spicedb_permissions` Statsig gate evaluates to ON for the subject user. Lets the admin checker surface a "would the directives actually enforce this on real traffic for that user?" signal next to the raw SpiceDB result. `null` when the user can't be loaded.

described.name: tagNames
described.description: Tag names provided in the import record.

described.name: tagNames
described.description: Tag names to apply to the organization. Tags must exist and belong to the managing organization or be global tags.

described.name: tags
described.description: Reference tag

described.name: temporalEnabled
described.description: Whether the Engine Next (org-level Temporal) toggle is on for this organization. Derived from the `organization_feature_preview_settings` row keyed by the Engine Next setting UUID — the catalog row's `label` is presentation-only and is NOT consulted by this resolver.

described.name: temporalFeaturePreviewAvailable
described.description: Whether the Engine Next feature-preview surface is available for this organization. True when the `ENABLE_WORKFLOW_TEMPORAL` Statsig gate is enabled for this org or one of its managing orgs. This controls row visibility/management affordances, not whether the org-level toggle is on.

described.name: theme
described.description: Site wide theme

described.name: useCustomDomain
described.description: Whether to use the custom domain

described.name: userFilter
described.description: Scope. Exactly one of `userFilter` / `userIds` / `roleIds` must be provided: - userFilter: apply to every user matching the filter (server-side expansion of org + optional search) - userIds: apply to an explicit user id list (drawer's "this page" scope for the Users tab) - roleIds: apply to an explicit role id list (drawer's Roles tab)

described.name: userTotalCount
described.description: Total users matching the current org/search filter, ignoring pagination.

described.name: workflowId
described.description: The workflow this trigger belongs to, used by the drawer to deep-link back into the workflow builder with the trigger pre-selected. Workflow's owning org may differ from the form's owning org for managed/parent workflows.

described.name: zedtoken
described.description: SpiceDB zedtoken from the synchronous write-through to peck-order. Pass to the next `formPermissionState` query so its bulk Check reads with `Consistency.at_least_as_fresh(zedtoken)`. Null when the sync RPC failed gracefully — the CDC path will still converge; the client falls back to default consistency on the refetch.

described.name: zedtoken
described.description: SpiceDB zedtoken returned by a prior form-permission mutation on this form. When set, the server issues the underlying bulk permission check with `Consistency.at_least_as_fresh(zedtoken)` so the refetch reflects the caller's own write. Closes the CDC propagation window.
